01 — The Saga

Enlighten through the fight.

ENFIGHTEN is a story about the fights that make us. Not the young hero chasing a belt. The old master who already won and lost everything, and keeps stepping back in.

The Logline

A 62-year-old fighter with 40 years on the mat knows every fight is a lesson. Now he has to pass them on, before the fighter he used to be gets there first.

The Master

The Old Man

40 years of rounds. Still training. He doesn't fight to win anymore. He fights to understand.

The Students

The Young Ones

Fast, strong, and lost. They want to learn to hit. He teaches them to stay in the round.

The Rival

The Man He Was

All ego, all anger. The fighter the Master used to be, and the one he still has to beat.

Michael Weiner · Austin, TX
02 — The Master Is Real

40 years on the mat.

I'm Michael. I started training over 40 years ago. I'm 62 now, and I'm still on the mat.

Karate · Yoga · Jiu-Jitsu · Muay Thai · MMA

Every round taught me something about fear, and about letting go of my beliefs. ENFIGHTEN is what the fight has taught me. The story is fiction. The lessons are not.

I had many inspirations: people still training late in life. Others made it possible for me. This story is how I pass it on.
